## Activity

During June 2022, East City Eye Clinic recorded 181 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. No change to the reported capture total is identified in the available information.

## Image quality

Of the 181 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. This result is reported for the full month and should be considered alongside the total capture activity. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 43 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 24 days. These figures summarise the grading position for June 2022 at East City Eye Clinic. The activity, image quality and grading measures are presented together to support routine site monitoring.
